mapper.select:
SELECT ot.owned_id, tm.model_id, tm.manufacturer, tm.name, tm.transport_category, tm.lap_time, tm.top_speed, tm.price, tm.release_date, tm.upgrade_location, tm.source, tm.weight, tm.drive_train, tm.seats, tm.features,
lap_rank.lap_rank, lap_rank.lap_category_rank, lap_rank.lap_total_count, lap_rank.lap_category_total_count,
speed_rank.speed_rank, speed_rank.speed_category_rank, speed_rank.speed_total_count, speed_rank.speed_category_total_count,
g.garage_id, ugs.alias, ugs.description, ugs.collapsed_yn, CASE WHEN ot.storage_type = 'PEGASUS' THEN '페가수스' WHEN ot.storage_type = 'UNASSIGNED' THEN '미배치' WHEN ot.storage_type = 'HANGAR' THEN '격납고 격납층' WHEN ot.storage_type = 'HANGAR_STORAGE' THEN '격납고 저장소' WHEN ot.storage_type = 'HANGAR_VINEWOOD' THEN '격납고 바인우드 클럽 보관소' ELSE g.name END AS garage_name, CASE WHEN ot.storage_type IN ( 'PEGASUS', 'UNASSIGNED', 'HANGAR', 'HANGAR_STORAGE', 'HANGAR_VINEWOOD' ) THEN NULL ELSE ots.slot_no END AS slot_no, ot.storage_type, ot.remark, ot.image_url, ot.decal, ot.acquired_yn, ot.mansion_position
FROM owned_transport ot INNER JOIN transport_model tm ON tm.model_id = ot.model_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ranked_lap.model_id, ranked_lap.lap_rank, ranked_lap.lap_category_rank, ranked_lap.lap_total_count, ranked_lap.lap_category_total_count FROM ( SELECT tm_inner.model_id, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tm_inner.lap_time ASC) AS lap_rank, COUNT(*) OVER () AS lap_total_count, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY tm_inner.transport_category) AS lap_category_total_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY tm_inner.transport_category ORDER BY tm_inner.lap_time ASC ) AS lap_category_rank FROM transport_model tm_inner WHERE tm_inner.lap_time IS NOT NULL AND tm_inner.lap_time > 0 ) ranked_lap ) lap_rank ON lap_rank.model_id = tm.model_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ranked_speed.model_id, ranked_speed.speed_rank, ranked_speed.speed_category_rank, ranked_speed.speed_total_count, ranked_speed.speed_category_total_count FROM ( SELECT tm_inner.model_id, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tm_inner.top_speed DESC) AS speed_rank, COUNT(*) OVER () AS speed_total_count, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY tm_inner.transport_category) AS speed_category_total_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY tm_inner.transport_category ORDER BY tm_inner.top_speed DESC ) AS speed_category_rank FROM transport_model tm_inner WHERE tm_inner.top_speed IS NOT NULL AND tm_inner.top_speed > 0 ) ranked_speed ) speed_rank ON speed_rank.model_id = tm.model_id
LEFT JOIN owned_transport_storage ots ON ots.owned_id = ot.owned_id LEFT JOIN garage g ON g.garage_id = ots.garage_id LEFT JOIN user_garage_setting ugs ON ugs.garage_id = g.garage_id AND ugs.user_id = #{userId}
WHERE ot.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY g.sort_order IS NULL, g.sort_order ASC,
-- 격납층 정렬 CASE WHEN ot.storage_type = 'HANGAR' THEN COALESCE(ot.hangar_sort_order, 999999) END ASC,
-- 격납고 저장소 / 바인우드 CASE WHEN ot.storage_type IN ('HANGAR_STORAGE', 'HANGAR_VINEWOOD') AND tm.features LIKE '%HGS%' THEN 1 WHEN ot.storage_type IN ('HANGAR_STORAGE', 'HANGAR_VINEWOOD') AND tm.features LIKE '%HGM%' THEN 2 WHEN ot.storage_type IN ('HANGAR_STORAGE', 'HANGAR_VINEWOOD') AND tm.features LIKE '%HGL%' THEN 3 WHEN ot.storage_type IN ('HANGAR_STORAGE', 'HANGAR_VINEWOOD') AND tm.features LIKE '%HGX%' THEN 4 ELSE 999 END ASC,
-- 페가수스 : 분류 → 제조사 → 모델명 CASE WHEN ot.storage_type = 'PEGASUS' THEN tm.transport_category END ASC,
CASE WHEN ot.storage_type IN ('PEGASUS', 'HANGAR_STORAGE', 'HANGAR_VINEWOOD') THEN tm.manufacturer END ASC,
CASE WHEN ot.storage_type IN ('PEGASUS', 'HANGAR_STORAGE', 'HANGAR_VINEWOOD') THEN tm.name END ASC,
-- 미배치 : 제조사 → 모델명 CASE WHEN ot.storage_type = 'UNASSIGNED' THEN tm.manufacturer END ASC,
CASE WHEN ot.storage_type = 'UNASSIGNED' THEN tm.name END ASC,
ots.slot_no IS NULL, ots.slot_no ASC, ot.owned_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO owned_transport ( model_id, user_id, storage_type, remark, image_url, decal, acquired_yn, mansion_position ) VALUES ( #{modelId}, #{userId}, #{storageType}, #{remark}, #{imageUrl}, #{decal}, IFNULL(#{acquiredYn}, 'Y'), #{mansionPosition} )

INSERT INTO owned_transport_storage ( owned_id, garage_id, slot_no, user_id ) SELECT #{ownedId}, #{garageId}, #{slotNo}, #{userId} FROM dual WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM owned_transport ot WHERE ot.owned_id = #{ownedId} AND ot.user_id = #{userId} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM garage g WHERE g.garage_id = #{garageId} )

INSERT INTO owned_transport_storage ( owned_id, garage_id, slot_no, user_id, moved_at ) SELECT #{ownedId}, #{garageId}, #{slotNo}, #{userId}, NOW() FROM dual WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM owned_transport ot WHERE ot.owned_id = #{ownedId} AND ot.user_id = #{userId} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM garage g WHERE g.garage_id = #{garageId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE owned_transport_storage SET garage_id = #{garageId}, slot_no = #{slotNo}, user_id = #{userId}, moved_at = NOW() WHERE owned_id = #{ownedId} AND user_id = #{userId}
